governance.parent: Department for Culture, Media and Sport
controls: approval of programme, loans or disposals by a ministry or council

basis: The 2026 to 2029 DCMS framework document (sections 3, 4, 8, 12, 21, 32) states the Museum and Galleries Act 1992 basis, the Board of Trustees appointing the Director with Prime Minister approval, and the audit, procurement and land approval rules.
The 2023/24 annual report pages 48 and 49 state a company limited by guarantee and registered charity whose Board appoints the Executive.
The 2024/25 annual report governance section states a charitable company limited by guarantee whose Trustees appoint the Chief Executive.
The orchestra's terms page names Royal Philharmonic Orchestra Ltd and the Companies House record lists it as a private limited company.

governance.parent: Science Museum Group, sponsored by the Department for Culture, Media and Sport

basis: The 2025 to 2028 DCMS framework document (sections 3, 4, 12, 21, 32) states the National Heritage Act 1983 basis and the rules for the Science Museum Group, whose about page lists the Science Museum in London as a member.

governance.parent: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

basis: The governance page names a non-departmental public body governed by the 1969 Order and 1833 Act whose Trustees appoint the Director, and the 2025 framework document (sections 21 and 32) states the procurement and audit rules.
The 2020/21 annual report structure and governance section states a company limited by guarantee and registered charity whose Trustees keep approval of the annual budget.
The gallery's board page states it has been an independent registered charity managed by a board of trustees since 2003.
The about page states a registered charity and the staff and trustees page lists its Board of Trustees.
